candidate_statement_family_not_credited: For independent coordinates X_i and a real function f whose value changes by at most c_i when only coordinate i is replaced, a common one-sided form bounds P(f(X) - E[f(X)] >= t) by exp(-2*t^2 / sum c_i^2).
